name: lispan_rate_wave3
description: Phase 3a wave 3: the wave-2 recipe (120 000 Adam steps, charge inventory from 40 000) WITHOUT the weight guard (wave 2: it pinned the salt and inventory weights at the 1000 cap in both failed runs; the same seed without it, wave-1 rate_w96_120k_s0, reached 0.15 mV) and with the rollback baseline changed to the lowest 500-step median of the last 5000 steps (rollback_horizon), so that slow kinetics ramps fire instead of dragging the baseline along. Best evaluation over the anchor rates kept as best.pt. Validated by replaying the two wave-1 runaways (docs/PHASE3_PARAMETRIC_PINN.md, Wave 2).
